description: Change supported text, color or hidden state on one returned editable canvas element. A null edit restores its authored content. Preserve authored animation. Read get_project_context first. Saves a new version at once (restore_version undoes it); a change it cannot make is refused and nothing changes. Uses the direct-edit allowance. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: From get_project_context; the live version when left out.

edit.description: Any of text, color (#RRGGBB) and hidden; null restores its authored content.

element.description: An editable element id from get_project_context.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

output_id.description: A hook, Short or shape from check_video; the main video when left out.

name: set_element_content

outputSchema.description: Clypmint set_element_content result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Change an element
